fields.name: Time Warp
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Swap with an enemy hero in range who has already resolved a card this turn.
• An enemy hero in range swaps their unresolved card with one of their resolved cards of their choice.

fields.name: Time Bomb
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in range who has already resolved a card this turn discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Back to the Future
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Place a unit in range into the space where that unit was at the start of this turn.
• Move an enemy hero in range, who remained in the same space since the last turn, 2 spaces in a straight line.

fields.name: Future Proof
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• You, and friendly heroes in radius, may retrieve all cards discarded this turn.
• This turn: Friendly heroes in radius are immune to enemy actions.

fields.name: Temporal Judgment
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you; when defending, the enemy hero must use the :initiative: Initiative value of their card and items instead of the :defense: Defense value of their card and items.

fields.name: Déjà Vu
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: You may place 2 :glitch_token: Glitch tokens in radius, with at least two spaces between each token; if you do, up to 1 enemy hero in radius swaps with a Glitch token of their choice.
End of turn: Remove all Glitch tokens.

fields.name: Time Loop
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy hero in range who has already resolved a card this turn.

fields.name: Time Trap
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in range who has already resolved a card this turn discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Fast Forward
fields.effect_text: Move an enemy hero in range, who remained in the same space since the last turn, 2 spaces in a straight line.

fields.name: Time Capsule
fields.effect_text: You, and friendly heroes in radius, may retrieve all cards discarded this turn.

fields.name: Temporal Slam
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you; when defending, the enemy hero must use the :initiative: Initiative value of their card and items instead of the :defense: Defense value of their card and items.

fields.name: Flashback
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: You may place 3 :glitch_token: Glitch tokens in radius, with at least two spaces between each token; if you do, up to 1 enemy hero in radius swaps with a Glitch token of their choice.
End of turn: Remove all Glitch tokens.

fields.name: Time Snare
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in range who has already resolved a card this turn discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Time Walk
fields.effect_text: Move an enemy hero in range, who remained in the same space since the last turn, 2 spaces in a straight line.

fields.name: Temporal Punch
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you; when defending, the enemy hero must use the :initiative: Initiative value of their card and items instead of the :defense: Defense value of their card and items.
( Minion defense modifiers are applied as normal. )

fields.name: Unstable Timeline
fields.effect_text:
Place 2 :glitch_token: Glitch tokens in radius, with at least two spaces between each token; if used as a defense, place 3 tokens instead.
An enemy hero in play chooses one of the Glitch tokens; you swap with that token.
End of turn: Remove all Glitch tokens.

fields.name: Reverse Time
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack:
Next turn: Heroes with lower initiative act before heroes with higher initiative; this effect ignores immunity.
( Resolve ties as normal. )

fields.name: Alternative Timelines
fields.effect_text: You may play two cards each turn; if you do, after the cards are revealed, retrieve one of your unresolved cards.

fields.name: Ebb and Flow
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range; if it was adjacent to you, may repeat once.

fields.name: Stranger Tide
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point.

fields.name: Deluge
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Master Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This round: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Violent Torrent
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 5 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated. May repeat once on a different unit.

fields.name: Tidal Blast
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 3 spaces.

fields.name: Arcane Whirlpool
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range.

fields.name: Magical Current
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Expert Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This turn: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Slippery Ground
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes adjacent to you cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Rogue Wave
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Raging Stream
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 3 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Spell Break
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot perform skill actions, except on gold cards.

fields.name: Noble Blade
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: You may move another unit that is adjacent to the target 1 space.

fields.name: Aspiring Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers.

fields.name: Dangerous Current
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 2 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Liquid Leap
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Living Tsunami
fields.effect_text: Once per turn, before performing an Attack action, you may move 1 space.

fields.name: Throwing Spear
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• You may discard a card. If you have a card in the discard, target a unit in range.

fields.name: Furious Charge
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: Move 2, 3, or 4 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.

fields.name: Master Skald
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in range gains 2 coins; if any hero was defeated this round, that friendly hero gains 4 coins instead.

fields.name: Fortify
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a basic card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Counterattack
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero adjacent to you who has played an attack card this turn discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Savage Kick
fields.effect_text: Move up to 2 spaces. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Throwing Axe
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• You may discard a card; if you do, target a unit in range.

fields.name: Bullrush
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: Move 2 or 3 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.

fields.name: War Drummer
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in range gains 1 coin; if any hero was defeated this round, that friendly hero gains 3 coins instead.

fields.name: Bolster
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a silver card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Shield Bash
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero adjacent to you who has played an attack card this turn discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Mighty Punch
fields.effect_text: You may move 1 space. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Bulwark
fields.effect_text:
You may retrieve a discarded card.
This turn: You and friendly units in radius cannot be moved, pushed, swapped or placed by enemy heroes.

fields.name: Onslaught
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: Move into the space it occupied, if able.

fields.name: Shield
fields.effect_text:
This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a silver card. If you do, the minion is not removed.
(The enemy hero still gains the coins for defeating the minion.)

fields.name: Brutal Jab
fields.effect_text: You may move 1 space. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 1 space.

fields.name: Mad Dash
fields.effect_text:
Before the attack: Move 2 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.
(If you cannot make this move, you cannot attack.)

fields.name: One Man Army
fields.effect_text: During minion battle you count as a heavy minion; if you would be removed, lose the push instead.

fields.name: Poisoned Dart
fields.effect_text: Give a hero in range a :poison_marker: Poison marker. The hero with a poison marker has -2 :initiative: Initiative, -2 :attack: Attack and -2 :defense: Defense.

fields.name: Master Thief
fields.effect_text: Move up to 2 spaces. Take 1 or 2 coins from an enemy hero adjacent to you; if you do, you may move up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Riposte
fields.effect_text: Block a non-ranged attack. The attacker discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Evade
fields.effect_text: Block a ranged attack. You may move 1 space. You may retrieve your resolved or discarded basic skill card.

fields.name: Backstab with a Ballista
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range; if a friendly unit is adjacent to the target +2 :attack: Attack, and the target cannot perform a primary action to defend.

fields.name: Leaping Strike
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: You may move 1 space. Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: You may move 1 space.

fields.name: Poisoned Dagger
fields.effect_text: Give a hero in range a Poison marker. The hero with a poison marker has -1 :initiative: Initiative, -1 :attack: Attack and -1 :defense: Defense.

fields.name: Pick Pocket
fields.effect_text: Move up to 2 spaces. Take 1 coin from an enemy hero adjacent to you; if you do, you may move 1 space.

fields.name: Sidestep
fields.effect_text: Block a ranged attack. You may move 1 space.

fields.name: Parry
fields.effect_text: Block a non-ranged attack. The attacker discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Combat Reflexes
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: You may move 1 space. Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: If you did not move before the attack, you may move 1 space.

fields.name: Backstab
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you; if a friendly unit is adjacent to the target, +2 :attack: Attack. (A "friendly unit" is another hero or a minion on your team.)

fields.name: Blend Into Shadows
fields.effect_text: If you are adjacent to terrain, place yourself into a space in radius; if you do, Next turn: You are immune to enemy attack actions.

fields.name: Blink Strike
fields.effect_text:
Before the attack: Move 2 spaces in a straight line through an enemy unit; target that unit.
(If you cannot make this move, you cannot attack.)

fields.name: Hit and Run

fields.name: Light-Fingered
fields.effect_text: You may move 1 space. Take 1 coin from an enemy hero adjacent to you; if you do, you may move 1 space.

fields.effect_text: Block a ranged attack.

ultimate_card.name: Cloak and Daggers

deck.name: Time Warp
deck.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Swap with an enemy hero in range who has already resolved a card this turn.
• An enemy hero in range swaps their unresolved card with one of their resolved cards of their choice.

deck.name: Time Bomb
deck.effect_text: An enemy hero in range who has already resolved a card this turn discards a card, or is defeated.

deck.name: Back to the Future
deck.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Place a unit in range into the space where that unit was at the start of this turn.
• Move an enemy hero in range, who remained in the same space since the last turn, 2 spaces in a straight line.

deck.name: Future Proof
deck.effect_text:

• You, and friendly heroes in radius, may retrieve all cards discarded this turn.
• This turn: Friendly heroes in radius are immune to enemy actions.
